remote.accessDesc: When enabled, devices on the same LAN can reach this machine via a browser. A password is required to sign in; no password, no access.
remote.restartHint: Takes effect immediately; other connected devices drop briefly — reload to reconnect.
remote.devicesDesc: All clients currently connected to this service (desktop windows and browsers).
remote.kickHint: Kicking only drops the connection, credentials stay valid; refresh the password or restart the app to fully invalidate.
remote.lanPasswordDesc: Strong password used by LAN devices to sign in. Every enable refreshes and shows a new password; a fixed password is persisted and stays valid while enabled and across restarts.
remote.passwordPolicy: At least 10 characters, must include digits, letters and symbols.
remote.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters
remote.qrDesc: Local access needs no password; LAN devices scan, open, then sign in with the password.
remote.qrDisabledHint: Once LAN access is enabled, the LAN address and access QR code appear here.
